🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE 🎃

Every swing makes you stronger. Train at the bays, then step up and send it.

⛳ Hit the ball further every time you level up and Fight Bosses
🏆 Land it further down the course for more Wins
🎯 Time your swing for a PERFECT hit
🕳️ Sink a hole in one for fireworks and bonus rewards
🥚 Hatch pets that boost your Wins
🔁 Rebirth to unlock new trainers and biomes
🌙 Hit it hard enough and it goes to the moon... and opens World 2

Daily rewards, free gifts for playing, and events every 15 minutes (Lucky Hour, Candy Corn Madness, Lightning Rush).

Join the group for a free reward chest!

👍 Like the game
